author: H.E.Petersen, 1924

note.en: A fine, banded red thread that tangles on bigger seaweeds, mangrove roots and wood, recorded as a rare epiphyte at Cahuita and from Portete near Limón.
note.es: Un hilo rojo fino y con bandas que se enreda sobre algas más grandes, raíces de mangle y madera, registrado como epífito raro en Cahuita y en Portete, cerca de Limón.

evidence: Samper-Villarreal et al. 2008: rare on turtle grass at Punta Cahuita
GBIF herbarium specimens: Punta Cahuita (1972) and Portete near Limón (Dawson)

sources.t: Samper-Villarreal, Bernecker & Wehrtmann 2008, Inventory of macroalgal epiphytes on Thalassia testudinum in Parque Nacional Cahuita, Revista de Biología Tropical 56 (Suppl. 4)
GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)
